Panel A explains the outcome to a cohort the visits never observed: the 2018/19 school-level Progress 8, with the intake controls either swapped to that era's values (KS2 APS of the GCSE cohort and FSM share) or held at current values, beside the contemporaneous outcome on the same 93 schools. A formal test of the placebo-vs-contemporaneous difference (the two outcomes stacked on the 93 common schools, each with its own full parameter set, standard errors clustered by school) does not reject equality: era-controls comparison $p=0.17$ (warmth), $p=0.62$ (strictness); all-current-controls comparison $p=0.09$ and $p=0.57$.
